system.description:
You release a pulse of chakra targeting all allied creatures within 30 feet of you causing them feel deep seeded Pride or ambition. Whenever an allied creature makes an attack roll or saving throw during this jutsu’s duration, they can roll an additional 1d4 and add the number rolled to their Attack and Saving throws.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the radius by 10-feet.
